lessons.title: What is a blockchain?
lessons.description: Start from zero: the problem every blockchain exists to solve, and how it solves it.
mustCover: the learner can explain what a blockchain stores and why the only edit it allows is an append, by relating it to a structure they already use
the learner can say why no single operator can rewrite the record, and what makes that expensive rather than merely forbidden
the learner can state what a builder gains by having no administrator, and what they give up for it
mustNotCover: the UTXO model, inputs and outputs, or change
private keys, public keys, and addresses beyond a <Term> gloss
Dash's masternodes, second tier, or confirmation speed

lessons.title: What is Dash?
lessons.description: What makes Dash different: cash that settles in about a second, and a second job.
mustCover: the learner can say what a payment on Dash feels like to the person receiving it, and how that differs from waiting on a block
the learner can say what masternodes do that ordinary nodes do not, and why the rest of Dash depends on them existing
the learner can decide which of Dash Core and Dash Platform a given feature belongs to
mustNotCover: re-teaching what a blockchain or a transaction is
the InstantSend versus ChainLock locking protocols

lessons.title: What is Dash Platform?
lessons.description: See what Dash Platform lets you build, and what you will build here.
mustCover: the learner can describe where an app's data lives on Platform and who is allowed to change it
the learner can name something they could build on Platform that they could not build on Dash Core alone
the learner can recognise, from a feature request, whether Platform is the right tool for it

lessons.title: Why build on Dash?
lessons.description: Decide when Dash is a good fit for an application.

lessons.title: Environment setup
lessons.description: Install the SDK, connect to Dash Platform, and make a verified read.

lessons.title: DAPI and Proofs
lessons.description: Understand what answered your first request, and why you can trust the answer.

lessons.description: Understand Platform identities, keys, credits, and their relationship to wallets.

lessons.title: Wallets, keys, and testnet
lessons.description: Handle keys safely and get the testnet funds the next lessons need.
mustCover: what a private key controls, and what losing it costs
getting testnet Dash from a faucet

lessons.title: Fund a Platform address
lessons.description: Derive and fund a Platform address for identity creation.

lessons.description: Create and verify a Dash Platform identity on testnet.

lessons.description: Design and publish a small data contract.
